$comment: Engine ownership registry (docs/audits/ARGUS_POST_MIGRATION_ARCHITECTURE_AUDIT.md, ARGUS_JAVA_ENGINE_ACTIVATION_PLAN.md Phase 1). Classifications below are derived from that audit's source/build/runtime evidence, not invented. Regenerate this file's entries only after re-verifying against real source/tests - never hand-wave a status. Status values: NODE_AUTHORITATIVE, JAVA_AUTHORITATIVE, JAVA_ADVISORY, PARITY_SHADOW, NODE_ONLY, JAVA_ONLY, DEPRECATED_CANDIDATE. javaAuthoritative for every entry below is false - nothing in this codebase has ever reached that status; do not flip it without the Phase 8 authoritative-mode work and a real soak.

atr.javaLocation: SymbolState.tickRangeAtr (tick-range approximation, NOT equivalent to Node's)
atr.liveConsumer: Node only - Java's version is a disclosed, non-equivalent approximation

quantModels.$comment: status is the real, formalized promotion ladder (src/server/config/modelRegistry.ts is the validating loader + rules, not just this comment): RESEARCH -> BACKTEST -> WALK_FORWARD -> SHADOW (running continuously against real live/replay data, output observed/logged, zero decision influence) -> PAPER -> VALIDATED -> PRODUCTION_CANDIDATE, plus terminal DEPRECATED/DISABLED reachable from any non-terminal rung. Promotion is strictly one rung at a time (modelRegistry.ts's isValidPromotion enforces this in code, not just narratively) and is always a reviewed edit to this file, never a live/automatic toggle. No model here has ever been promoted past SHADOW - VALIDATED/PRODUCTION_CANDIDATE require real backtest+walk-forward+paper-soak evidence that does not exist yet for any of these.
quantModels.$outputTypeComment: outputType formally separates Directional Alpha Providers (produce a signed side that may feed QuantEnsembleEngine) from Conditioning/Volatility Modifiers (produce structural context - regime, variance - used only to scale/gate an ensemble result downstream via RegimeVolatilityOverlay, never to vote themselves) from infra/portfolio-risk inputs. Forcing a Conditioning Modifier into a directional vote would corrupt the ensemble - see RegimeVolatilityOverlay.java's own header.
